instruction: Write flatten.py: nested.json holds nested objects; emit flat.json mapping dotted paths to scalar values (arrays become index paths like 'a.0'). Run it.

grader.script: python3 flatten.py && python3 -c "import json; f=json.load(open('flat.json')); assert f=={'a.b.c':1,'d.0':2,'d.1':3,'e':'x'}"
